comment: Cycloalkene >= 8 mandatory E/Z fixtures (P-31.1.3 Sep 2024 errata). Per D-07, the existing strain filter at rules/stereochemistry.py:85-95 already permits rings >= 8 (rejects only < 8); this fixture set documents the operational guarantee that the universal injector emits (E)- or (Z)- for every ring-size-8-12 cycloalkene. Per D-08, ring sizes >= 13 are out of fixture scope (filter still applies by mathematics). All entries sourced from benchmarks/*.csv per D-23. Per RESEARCH Pitfall 4, every SMILES carries explicit /= or \= geometry markers so RDKit assigns _CIPCode. The E/Z assertion uses re.search(r'^\([^)]*[0-9][EZ]', name) to detect the [EZ] descriptor anywhere in the leading P-91 block (handles names like '(4S,7Z,...)' where the E/Z descriptor is preceded by an R/S descriptor). 5/6 fixtures xfail the OPSIN round-trip per D-22 (the always-run gates per BL-04 still assert the (E)- or (Z)- block emission, which IS the SC#2 contract).

compounds.comment: (1Z,6S)-2,6-dimethyl-4-neopentylcycloocta-1,4-diene; ring_size 8 boundary case for P-31.1.3 errata
compounds.xfail_reason: opsin-cli-2.9.0-cannot-roundtrip-fused-cyclooctadiene-name-shape; v19 owns name-format reconciliation. Always-run E/Z assertion still applies.
